confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Ljubljana's price levels, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and room rates vary widely by location and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer-to-drink relationship because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with mid-sized Central European capitals with similar summer tourism demand, such as Zagreb, Graz and Bratislava, adjusted upward toward Vienna-level pricing for the summer tourist season. Euro-denominated prices converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15.
